hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; b="$(basename "$f")"; case "$b" in .env|.env.*) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Editing .env files is blocked by project policy.\"}}";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [ -f "$f" ] && cd "$(dirname "$f")" && npx --no-install prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
